answer.original_source: Corning Chairman, CEO and President Wendell Weeks, quoted by Fox News Digital; statement published 2026-07-01.
answer.new_information: Weeks said Corning was in its fastest growth period and would probably double its size over the coming years, with almost all new hires in advanced manufacturing and a significant part of them in the United States. This is a forward-looking company statement, not a reported result. “Size” and “over the coming years” are not defined. No stored questions or catalog entries were supplied to connect it to. It is distinct from the article’s separate claims about the Corning-NVIDIA facilities, expected 3,000-plus jobs and tenfold U.S. optical manufacturing capacity; those measures do not define or confirm a doubling of Corning’s overall size.
